$comment: Every export of @akshayanimateddsa/site-ui, one line each (test/catalogue.test.js checks this list against the code). Look here before writing a new site component: a generic one goes into this package.

calendar.createCalendar: An Outlook-style calendar in an element: toolbar (Today, ‹ ›, title, view switch), a small month in a sidebar, and Day / Week time grids (half-hour lines, red now line, side-by-side overlaps, drag to pick a span) or a Month of day cells with event chips.
calendar.CALENDAR_VIEWS: The three views in switch order: day, week, month.

booking.createBookingCalendar: The calendar with 1:1 booking: admin adds available blocks (one-off or weekly), sets session lengths, confirms or declines requests; student picks a session kind, sees open slots and requests one; admin can preview the student view.
booking.NOTE_MAX: The longest note a student can send with a request (500 characters).

slots.expandAvailability: Available blocks (one-off or repeating weekly until a day) as dated occurrences in a span, in a time zone.
slots.openSlots: The bookable slots: availability cut into back-to-back slots of a length, minus busy times and the past.
slots.isOpenSlot: Whether a span is exactly one open slot: the server's check before taking a booking.
slots.overlaps: Whether two spans share any time (touching ends don't).

layout.eventsOnDay: The events touching a day, in start order.
layout.layoutDay: An event's piece on a day of the time grid: its minutes from midnight and its column among overlapping events.
layout.daySpan: The instants a day starts and ends in a time zone.

dates.zonedParts: An instant's wall-clock year, month, day, hour, minute and weekday in a time zone.
dates.zonedTime: The instant a time zone's clock shows given minutes past midnight on a day.
dates.dayKeyOf: The day ('YYYY-MM-DD') an instant falls on in a time zone.
dates.minuteOfDay: An instant's minutes since midnight in a time zone.
dates.parseDayKey: A day's year, month and day of month (throws on a malformed day).
dates.addDays: The day n days later (or earlier).
dates.addMonths: The same day of the month n months later, kept inside a shorter month.
dates.daysBetween: Whole days from one day to another.
dates.startOfWeek: The first day of a day's week (weeks start Monday unless told otherwise).
dates.weekDays: The 7 days of a day's week.
dates.startOfMonth: The first day of a day's month.
dates.monthGrid: A month as whole weeks (4–6 rows of 7 days), as a wall calendar shows it.
dates.startOfDay: The instant a day starts in a time zone.

dialog.openDialog: A modal dialog on <dialog>: title, body, action buttons that may be async (errors shown inside, the dialog stays open).

css.css/calendar.css: The calendar and booking calendar: toolbar, sidebar, small month, time grid, month cells, event blocks and chips, booking panels, phone layout; every colour a --cal-* token (Outlook-like light defaults) a site sets to its theme.
css.css/dialog.css: The modal dialog, its form fields and buttons, and the booking details list; tokens --ui-* default to the calendar's --cal-*.
